title: Round 26's neto2 against round 25's net2: the DAgger twins in closed loop on validation links, 14 policies
description: Round 25 (exp-net2-r25-v9-249) and round 26 (exp-neto2-r26-v2-254) trained the same online DAgger recipe (round 18's gate3 students, teacher gain 0.5, seeds 1 to 3) on the same 27 LCFs: round 25 on net1 v9 (a distribution per LCF), read as distributions (r25-bins) or as means (r25-means); round 26 on neto1 v2 (one value per LCF), with the rule at u = 0.25 (round 25's u; r26-u0.25) or at u = 0.375 (neto1 v2's chosen u; r26-u0.375) as teacher and start. Their students after iteration 39, fixed beforehand as in exp-net2-vs-neto2-val-253, run here in closed loop beside BBRv3 and, as reference lines only, the rule on net1 v9 at u = 0.25 (rule-v9) and on neto1 v2 at u = 0.375 (rule-v2), on the five validation families and as 2 and 4 copies, campaign seed 21 as in release 253. The iteration 39 policies come from small model releases (model-net2-r25, model-neto2-r26), because the training releases are too large to fetch in every shard. r25-means against r26-u0.25 is the pair in which only the estimator differs. Read per-arm means over the three training seeds. Validation links before tuning; no claim about the test links.
prepare: N9="$IN/v9/$(cat "$IN/v9/chosen.txt")/net1.pt"; N2="$IN/v2/$(cat "$IN/v2/chosen.txt")/net1.pt"; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/v9" "$N9" --u 0.25; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/v2" "$N2" --u 0.375; P=(--policy "rule-v9=$OUT/v9/rule-u0.25.onnx" --policy "rule-v2=$OUT/v2/rule-u0.375.onnx"); (cd "$IN/r" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); (cd "$IN/q" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); for f in "$IN"/r/ppo-r25-*-i39.onnx "$IN"/q/ppo-r26-*-i39.onnx; do n="$(basename "$f" -i39.onnx)"; P+=(--policy "${n#ppo-}=$f"); done; [ "${#P[@]}" -eq 28 ]; experiments/rule_eval.sh "$OUT" val 21 21 bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run python experiments/copies.py "$OUT/copies" --split val --duration-ms 30000 --seed 21 --n 2 4 --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; mv "$OUT/copies/c-copies-30s" "$OUT/"; jq -s add "$OUT/aliases.json" "$OUT/copies/aliases.json" > "$OUT/a.json"; mv "$OUT/a.json" "$OUT/aliases.json"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done; uv run python experiments/slim_steps.py "$OUT"
collect: uv run python experiments/rule_report.py "$OUT" --apart copies-30s --best r25-bins r25-means r26-u0.25 r26-u0.375 && uv run python experiments/versus_rule.py "$OUT" rule-v9
